planning_notes: Analog input A0 is continuously sampled by the catalog operation; exact sampling period and ADC scaling are left to the model/application defaults.
1 second reporting cadence is implemented in SysML using elapsed_ms; the serial trigger must assert when the accumulated delta reaches 1000ms (first step delay behavior defined in SysML).
Serial framing is assumed line-oriented or idle completion (line_or_idle) with idle_timeout_ms=20; no explicit per-line CR/LF requirement was provided.
Reported numeric format is assumed to be a single floating-point value corresponding to the analog_input f64 value.
